findings.reason: All five original-resolution tiles contain the complete proof but no figure. The reversal of conormal maps on dualizing and the distinction between an étale local model and the global blowup materially benefit from explicit diagrams. Under the authorized editorial criterion these diagrams are warranted.
findings.action: Appended final Remarks with four diagrams: two exact sequences, the Cartesian local immersion square, and the Cartesian local blowup square. Added exact map, rank, coordinate and base conventions.

correction: Appended final Remarks only; preserved the entire original source as an exact byte prefix, including every claim and proof step and all frontmatter. No existing figure mathematics was changed.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: Conormal sequence on X over k: alpha:I/I^2 -> i*Omega^1_Y/k sends [f] to 1 tensor df; beta:i*Omega^1_Y/k -> Omega^1_X/k restricts differentials.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: alpha is injective; im(alpha)=ker(beta); beta is surjective; beta alpha=0. These are exactly step 4.1 and the conormal supplier (whose general noninjective version is strengthened here by smoothness).
diagram_math_checks.justification: Steps 3.1 and 4.1 establish rank d conormal and locally split exactness, using F6/F7. Read thm-conormal-sequence-closed-immersion and thm-differentials-smooth-locally-free interfaces.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: Dual sequence: beta^vee:T_X -> i*T_Y and alpha^vee:i*T_Y -> N_X/Y, where N_X/Y=(I/I^2)^vee.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Finite locally free duality reverses the original arrows; alpha^vee beta^vee=0 and the dual sequence is short exact. No vertical map or self-duality is asserted. Ranks in the two sequences are d,m,n and n,m,d.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 4.1 proves stalkwise finite-free splitting; d=m-n is given, and F7 identifies differential ranks with smooth relative dimensions.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: X_U -> U over A^n_k -> A^m_k; right map phi=(f_1,...,f_d,u_1,...,u_n), left map its restriction.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Both horizontal maps are closed immersions. The square commutes by restriction and is Cartesian since phi pulls (z_1,...,z_d) back to (f_1,...,f_d). phi is étale after shrinking U as in step 5.1.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Steps 2.1 and 5.1 explicitly prove ideal generation and étaleness; no assertion that U equals affine space or that phi is an isomorphism.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: V=U x_k A^1_t -> M=A^m_k x_k A^1_t via psi=phi x id, with t=0 at infinity. Centers C=X_U x_k {0}, C_0=A^n_k x_k {0}.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: The model ideal (z_1,...,z_d,t) pulls back to (f_1,...,f_d,t). Thus the center is the scheme-theoretic inverse image; psi is étale and hence flat.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 6.1 and definition of étale read locally. Restriction to the infinity chart is explicit; no arbitrary-base-change blowup statement used.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: B_V=Bl_C V -> B_M=Bl_C0 M with structural vertical maps pi_V, pi_M to V,M.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: Cartesian square B_V = V x_M B_M, so pi_M composed with the upper map equals psi composed with pi_V. The upper map is the base change of psi, hence étale. This is a local description, not a global model equality.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 6.1, F7/F9 and thm-blowup-base-change-flat (read statement and proof) apply because psi is flat and center ideals match.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: Model blowup chart coordinates for d+1 generators.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: t-chart has d ratios z_i/t, t, and n remaining coordinates; each z_j-chart has z_j, d-1 ratios z_l/z_j, t/z_j, n remaining coordinates. Each count is d+1+n=m+1; no chart type is omitted, including d=0 where only the t-chart remains.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 6.1 and the Rees/blowup definitions explicitly read; no claim that the pulled-back charts are themselves globally affine spaces.

diagram_math_checks.objects_maps: Base field and nonclosed point conventions.
diagram_math_checks.relations_checked: All diagram affine spaces/products are over k. Bundle ranks are O_X ranks and are dimensions only after tensoring with kappa(x); they are not dimensions of the local rings at nonclosed points. No rational-point or smooth/regular-base assumption for the separate section statement is added.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Step 1.1 and lem-affine-local-dimension-residue-transcendence use the same residue field for R and S; step 8.1 remains wholly unchanged and is not generalized in the diagrams.
